pages.text: $(l)Purpose$()$pEdits modules inside a Flawless Calculator. Removing the calculator takes its installed contents with it.$p$(l)Set up and operate$()$p1. Insert the Flawless Calculator in its labelled slot.$p2. Install supported modules into the module slots.$p3. Remove it and sneak-use it to choose an installed action.$p$(l)When it does not run$()$pAtomic Module and ordinary assembly ingredients are not automatically usable modules. See the installation chapter for accepted categories.$pRead the active server settings below before copying default costs from another installation. For special slot roles, use the machine screen labels. Settings reporting does not inspect or mutate a placed machine.$pActual server settings: live server values are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$pCrafting / obtaining this machine: live recipe details are available in the native or master Foundations reader.$p$(l:foundations_calculator:troubleshooting/no_progress)General operating checklist$()
